Help & FAQ
Upload
How do I Upload a CT scan?
Tap 'New Analysis' from the dashboard, enter patient details, then tap the upload area to select an image from your device. Supported formats: PNG, JPG
Analysis
What does the AI Confidence score mean?
The AI confidence score indicates how certain the model is about its detection. Scores above 90% are considered highly reliable. However, all results should be verified by a qualified radiologist.
Reports
Can I export reports as PDF?
Yes! After analysis is complete, tap the 'Download PDF' button on the report page. You can then share or print the PDF report.
Privacy
Is my patient data secure?
Yes. Scans, reports and identifiers are stored locally on a device in encrypted storage and are never uploaded unless you explicitly share a PDF or connect to an online API.
Account
How do I change my password?
Go to settings > Edit profile > Change password. Enter your current password and new password to update.
